'''2008 Worlds Day 2 Aaron Groth LS Dantooine Base Operations''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Aaron Groth]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 2).

* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]

* '''Stage:''' Day 2
